summary: Launch readiness: billing infrastructure, acceptance policy enforcement, token issuance, operator tooling, observability

security_fixes.description: Fix existing security vulnerabilities that undermine the trust model (Phase 0 from acceptance policy spec)

items.name: coincurve_import_hard_fail
items.description: Make coincurve ImportError a hard failure in production. Currently silently disables ALL signature verification — _schnorr_verify() returns True for any input if library missing.

items.name: require_created_at_on_writes
items.description: All relay write endpoints must require created_at and reject writes without it. Currently Optional[int] = None, omitting it skips signature verification entirely.

items.name: amlegal_client_hardening
items.description: Harden American Legal Publishing client: test parser on 2-3 more cities (LA, SF, Chicago), store Sacramento to Postgres, verify vector indexing pipeline.
items.notes: Parser rewritten with deterministic format detection + LLM fallback (1956d3a). Tested on 4 cities: Sacramento (8,236 sections), Gridley (2,071), Fairfax (1,649), Pinole (1,978). 6 new cities in JURISDICTION_MAP. Remaining: store Sacramento to Postgres, verify vector indexing.

observability.description: Usage logging and metrics across all deployed services

items.name: mcp_usage_logging
items.description: Wire usage_logging_middleware into MCP Modal server. Add civicos-platform secret to Modal deployment. Currently the only production service serving traffic has no usage logging.
items.notes: Added UsageLoggingMiddleware (raw ASGI), civicos-platform secret, _mcp_request_key_id context var. Fire-and-forget pattern via call_soon.

items.name: relay_usage_logging
items.description: Add usage logging to relay Modal server for coordination and AI proxy endpoints.
items.notes: Added UsageLoggingMiddleware (raw ASGI), mounted api_keys.py, civicos-platform secret. Fire-and-forget pattern via call_soon. key_id always None (relay uses Nostr signatures).

items.name: deploy_usage_rollup
items.description: Verify modal_usage_rollup.py is deployed as a cron job and the platform DB has the schema applied.
items.notes: Platform DB (Supabase axhmnnvefrtliyszbuou, us-west-1) created with 3 tables. Rollup runs as part of daily ingest (scheduled_high_velocity_refresh) to avoid Modal 5-cron limit. Standalone script kept for manual runs. civic-vectors cron removed (redundant with daily ingest).

items.name: acceptance_policy_monitoring
items.description: Add monitoring for relay acceptance policy: rejections by tier, rate limit hits/day, total writes by tier.
items.notes: coordination_acceptance_logs table in relay DB logs every acceptance decision (fire-and-forget). Admin endpoint GET /coordination/admin/acceptance-stats?days=7 returns writes/rejections by tier, daily breakdown, rate limit hits. cleanup_old_logs(30) runs on startup. Schema: scripts/sql/add_acceptance_monitoring.sql.

items.name: external_cron_triggers
items.description: Migrate Modal cron schedules to GitHub Actions scheduled workflows hitting Modal HTTP endpoints. Removes 5-cron-job plan limit and decouples scheduling from compute.
items.notes: Migrated 4 Modal crons to GH Actions workflows. Requires MODAL_TOKEN_ID + MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET repo secrets. Deploy modal_ingest.py to free cron slots.

items.notes: Webhook handler auto-provisions key but delivery is documented stub: 'raw_key delivery is manual for now'

items.name: billing_endpoint_deployment
items.description: Verify /api/billing/checkout and /api/billing/webhook are reachable on the deployed MCP server. May need to mount billing router in modal_mcp.py.

items.name: stripe_secrets_deployment
items.description: Verify STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and STRIPE_PRICE_* are configured in Modal secrets.

acceptance_policy.description: Relay acceptance policy enforcement — attestation verification and rate limiting hardening (Phases 2-3 from spec)

items.name: http_ip_rate_limiting
items.description: Add HTTP-level per-IP rate limiting on relay before crypto verification. First line of defense against spam.

items.name: nip13_proof_of_work
items.description: Add NIP-13 proof-of-work requirement for rate-limited (free) tier writes. 20-bit target ~1s computation. Provides sybil resistance for the free tier.
items.notes: _verify_pow wired into check() as tier 3, before rate limiting. Valid PoW bypasses rate limit. Configured per event type via pow_difficulty.

items.name: relay_write_metadata_table
items.description: Create relay_write_metadata table to store acceptance_tier per write. Avoids modifying frozen Voice model. Clients can filter/weight by tier.
items.notes: Implemented as coordination_write_metadata table

items.name: attestation_proof_on_requests
items.description: Add attestation_proof field to CastVoiceRequest and other write request schemas. Currently missing — prerequisite for attestation enforcement.
items.notes: attestation_proof added to Voice model and request schemas

items.name: wire_attestation_verification
items.description: Wire existing verify_attestation_proof() into acceptance policy check on all write endpoints. Look up trusted issuer pubkey from issuer_registry table.
items.notes: _verify_attestation wired to extract jurisdiction from j-tag, look up issuer via issuer_lookup callable, then call verify_attestation_proof(). app.py lifespan provides issuer_lookup from storage.issuers. Falls through gracefully when no issuer_lookup configured.

items.name: config_driven_rate_limits
items.description: Move DEFAULT_POLICY from hardcoded module-level constant to per-jurisdiction configuration (config file or DB table). Currently every relay instance has identical rate limits and PoW difficulty regardless of jurisdiction.
items.notes: load_policy() resolves: RELAY_POLICY_FILE env var → config/relay_policies.json[jurisdiction] → file defaults → DEFAULT_POLICY. Deep merge preserves per-event-type fields. AcceptancePolicy accepts jurisdiction_id param, RelayConfig reads RELAY_JURISDICTION env var. 10 new tests.

items.name: extension_pow_generation
items.description: Add NIP-13 proof-of-work generation to browser extension for free-tier writes. Server-side PoW verification is wired but no client generates it — dead code path until this ships.
items.notes: minePoW() in civicos-client adds NIP-13 nonce tag. castVoice() and castComment() mine transparently when no attestation proof. 16-bit difficulty, ~650ms avg on desktop. Cross-verified against Python server-side _verify_pow(). Extension builds clean.

items.name: attestation_expiry
items.description: Add attestation expiry check: created_at + validity_period > now. Recommend 1-year validity. Design revocation mechanism (blocklist of revoked attestation event IDs).

items.name: extension_402_handling
items.description: Update extension to handle HTTP 402 responses from relay gracefully. Show UX guidance for attestation or payment options.

token_issuance.description: Blinded token payment system for relay writes — privacy-preserving per-action billing (Phase 4 from spec)

items.name: blind_signature_scheme_design
items.description: Design blind signature scheme using existing secp256k1 primitives. Define token format, blinding protocol, and spent-token storage.
items.notes: Use secp256k1 blind signatures, not Cashu (deferred due to pre-1.0 status and regulatory risk)

items.name: token_issuance_service
items.description: Implement token issuance service (separate from relay). Accepts Stripe/Lightning payment, returns blinded tokens. Cannot link issued tokens to payment session.
items.notes: New service, likely deployed on Modal. Separate from relay for privacy boundary.

items.name: payment_proof_on_models
items.description: Add payment_proof: Optional[dict] to Voice, Comment, CivicActionEvent, CivicCommitment, CivicCompletion models and their request schemas.
items.notes: payment_proof added to Voice model

items.name: token_verification_in_policy
items.description: Add token verification + spent-token tracking to acceptance policy. Atomic: token must be marked spent BEFORE write is persisted.

items.name: extension_token_wallet
items.description: Add token wallet to browser extension. Store blinded tokens in local-wallet.ts (already handles secp256k1). Include tokens in write requests automatically.

items.name: token_purchase_ui
items.description: Token purchase flow in extension: Stripe checkout -> blinded tokens, and (future) Lightning -> blinded tokens.

operator_readiness.description: Tooling and documentation for external operators to run CivicOS instances

items.name: data_ingestion_guide
items.description: Public-facing guide for operators to ingest data for their jurisdiction. Currently noted as a gap in operator-guide.md — links to internal docs only.
items.notes: Rewritten with correct modal CLI commands, tiered cost model, verification steps, and accurate file paths. Old version referenced non-existent scripts.

items.name: registry_pr_workflow
items.description: Document and test the PR workflow for adding new jurisdictions to config/registry.json. Include CI validation of registry format.

items.name: query_engine_performance
items.description: Connection pooling, vector search tuning, and end-to-end profiling for cross-jurisdiction query performance under load.
items.notes: Three wins: (1) ThreadedConnectionPool in PostgresBackend — currently opens new TCP connection per query, biggest latency source. (2) Tune ef_search from 200 to ~80 — overkill for 17k vectors, trades unnecessary recall for speed. (3) Profile cross-jurisdiction latency with 3 cities, set performance baseline. Also unifies retry logic between civicos and civicos-relay backends.

items.name: operator_relay_dockerfile
items.description: Dockerfile for self-hosted relay deployment. Operator guide currently documents uvicorn command only.

items.name: query_interface_hardening
items.description: Harden v2 query interface: cursor pagination, aggregate/trend modes, live-data integration tests, ranking calibration. See docs/public/decisions/query_interface.md deferred items.
items.notes: Done: cursor pagination (stateless base64 offsets), aggregate mode (counts + date ranges), trend mode (year-month buckets), 19 new tests (88 total). Remaining: live-data integration tests and RRF ranking calibration moved to query_interface_operators.

items.name: configurable_refresh_policies
items.description: Configurable per-corpus refresh policies in jurisdiction YAML. Operators set interval and strategy for each data source (municipal_code, meetings, transcripts, etc.). System checks for changes and re-ingests only what changed.
items.notes: Core infrastructure done (fd77c05): RefreshRunner, CorpusProvider protocol (Municode fingerprint gate, AMLegal interval-only), YAML refresh: block, modal run --refresh CLI, safety valves (>50% modified or >20% removed), normalized text comparison, duplicate row defense, refresh.critic.md. 41 tests + real-data simulation. Remaining: (1) GH Actions cron workflow for scheduled --refresh, (2) extend RefreshRunner to meetings/issues/legislation corpus types, (3) operator notification on detected changes.

items.name: query_interface_operators
items.description: v2 query interface operators and cross-jurisdiction support: set operators (- for diff/monitoring, & for intersection), multi-jurisdiction fan-out, civic jargon lookup via civic.context. Also: live-data integration tests and RRF ranking calibration (from hardening). See docs/public/decisions/query_interface.md open questions.
items.notes: Done: diff mode, intersect mode, concept lookup (prev session). This session: 23 integration tests against PostgreSQL, RRF calibration (k=60 shows good 4:4 interleaving). Found: legislation/municipal_code timeout at 10s (what_applies takes ~40s due to external API calls). Multi-jurisdiction fan-out deferred until more cities onboarded.

federation_testbed.description: Private multi-city deployment for federation design and turnkey onboarding validation. Phase A: same-county (Marin), Phase B: cross-county (Berkeley/Alameda)

items.name: onboard_mill_valley
items.description: Run /onboard for Mill Valley (Granicus, Marin County). Document every manual step, friction point, and failure as onboarding checklist items.
items.notes: Done 2026-03-11. 56 meetings, 310 agenda items in Postgres. 7 friction points documented in docs/internal/onboarding-friction-log.md. Fixed: Granicus detection (view_id 1-5), agenda link extraction (URL pattern fallback).

items.name: onboard_san_anselmo
items.description: Run /onboard for San Anselmo (Granicus, Marin County). Second same-platform onboarding validates repeatability of the flow.
items.notes: Done 2026-03-11. 169 meetings, 337+ agenda items (extraction continuing). 28 body types. 0 new code fixes needed — Mill Valley fixes generalized. 3 pre-existing friction points remain (F1, F4, F5). Friction log updated.

items.name: deploy_marin_test_relays
items.description: Deploy 2 additional relay instances on Modal for Mill Valley and San Anselmo. Private, not public-facing. Validates multi-relay deployment.
items.notes: Same relay code, different jurisdiction config. Modal makes this cheap (serverless).

items.name: issue_test_attestations
items.description: Generate issuer keypairs for Mill Valley and San Anselmo. Register in issuer_registry. Test multi-issuer attestation verification across relays.
items.notes: Tests the issuer_lookup callable with 3 jurisdictions. Validates that attestation proofs are portable across relays.

items.name: marin_sibling_ingestion
items.description: Build a turnkey onboard-and-ingest flow, validate it by onboarding Mill Valley and San Anselmo end-to-end, then update docs so any operator can do the same.
items.source: federation testbed — data prerequisite for cross_marin_query_prototype + operator experience validation
items.notes: Done 2026-03-15. Turnkey onboard script (scripts/onboard.py) generates configs + runs Modal ingestion in one command. Mill Valley: 57 meetings, 166 agenda items, 2 decisions, 591 vectors. San Anselmo: 152 meetings, 34 new agenda items, 112 decisions, 1037 vectors. Both jurisdictions now have non-zero decisions + vectors. Chunks were 0/14 due to Granicus HTML agendas (MV) and SSL cert errors (SA) — not blocking.

items.name: turnkey_onboard_hardening
items.description: Add a validation gate (small sample + quality check before full backfill) and fix data quality gaps: HTML agenda chunk extraction for Granicus, duplicate meeting deduplication, post-onboard quality report, and idempotent re-runs.
items.source: marin_sibling_ingestion validation — gaps found during Mill Valley + San Anselmo onboarding
items.notes: Eight gaps identified: (0) No validation gate — ingests 365 days blind, should sample 30 days first, verify quality (chunks>0? decisions>0?), then scale up only if quality passes. Prevents burning $3-4 on jurisdictions with unextractable data. (1) Chunks=0 for Granicus HTML AgendaViewer sites — need to extract text from GeneratedAgendaViewer HTML pages when no PDF link exists. (2) Only 2/57 decisions for Mill Valley — thin HTML minutes, need quality signal. (3) Duplicate meetings from multi-view archives — view 2 and 3 contain same meetings, wastes LLM spend. (4) No post-onboard quality report — operator can't tell if results are good or bad. (5) County enrichment is fragile string patching on YAML. (6) No idempotency — re-run doubles LLM spend on agenda/decisions. (7) City name sensitivity — slug derivation is case/prefix sensitive. Must fix before open sourcing and before cross-jurisdiction queries can rely on this data.

items.name: cross_marin_query_prototype
items.description: Cross-jurisdiction queries within Marin County via v2 query layer. SearchRequest.include_parents/include_siblings with tier-based relevance boosting.
items.notes: Infrastructure done: jurisdiction resolution, tier boosting (self=1.0, sibling=0.8), parallel fan-out, semantic relevance scores (04792c2), noise filter MIN_RELEVANCE=0.45, 130+ tests. Data ready: SR 83 decisions, MV 60, SA 96. Decision IDs migrated to meeting-scoped ordinals (f08025f). Remaining: (1) downward resolution — query county-marin should fan out to child cities, (2) cache registry.json in memory, (3) mount v2 on REST API server.

items.name: onboarding_friction_log
items.description: Capture all manual steps, failures, and workarounds from Phase A onboarding. Convert to /onboard improvements and operator guide updates.
items.notes: This is the real deliverable of Phase A — a battle-tested onboarding flow, not a theoretical one.

items.name: turnkey_onboarding
items.description: Fix F1 (Granicus subdomain discovery) and F5 (registry generation from YAML) to make onboarding nearly turnkey. Provide a city name, get config + registrations generated automatically.
items.notes: F1: discover_granicus_subdomain() tries 5 URL patterns with root-page validation. F5: scripts/generate_registries.py reads YAMLs and patches all 3 registry files. onboard_jurisdiction() now accepts city_name param.

items.name: onboard_berkeley
items.description: Harden turnkey onboarding: fix geocoding state hardcode, stress test against SF/school boards, validate all 4 platforms end-to-end. Extends multi-platform discovery + LLM column map work from prior session.
items.notes: Fixed hardcoded state-california in geocode_city() and _generate_jurisdiction_yaml() fallback. Added _US_STATES lookup + _state_abbrev_to_slug() helper. Stress tested: Berkeley/CA, Austin/TX, Portland/OR, NYC/NY, Chicago/IL all produce correct state slugs. 13 new tests (7 state slug + 6 geocoding). 57/57 tests pass. All 3 existing jurisdictions verified.

items.name: onboard_county_alameda
items.description: Onboard Alameda County as parent jurisdiction for Berkeley. Required for cross-county legislation context in what_applies().
items.notes: Alameda County onboarded via turnkey pipeline. Also fixed 3 robustness bugs: (1) upfront API key warnings, (2) validate defaults to 1, (3) empty archives returns failure not success. Fixed YAML generator: level passthrough (was hardcoded 'city') and self-reference filtering in parent_jurisdictions. 88/88 tests pass (83 original + 5 new robustness tests).

items.name: escribe_client
items.description: Add eScribe platform client to close the last platform coverage gap (Portland, OR). Implement BaseExtractor, add to factory + platform_detection discovery. Enables turnkey onboarding for eScribe-based jurisdictions.
items.source: platform coverage gap — Portland OR uses eScribe, only unsupported platform found in stress testing
items.notes: Portland OR is the only major US city that failed platform discovery. eScribe is used by Portland and other Pacific NW cities. Existing abstraction (BaseExtractor + factory + discovery) is already generalizable — just needs a new client implementation.

items.name: cross_county_query_prototype
items.description: Prototype cross-county queries: Berkeley (Alameda) vs San Rafael (Marin). Test relevance filtering — when are cross-county results useful vs noise?
items.notes: Key question: a San Rafael user doesn't care about EBMUD. How does the query layer filter by relevance across county boundaries? State legislation is shared; county/regional is not.

items.name: pagination_protocol_update
items.description: Add limit/offset parameters to StorageBackend.get_*() methods. Informed by real cross-jurisdiction query patterns from testbed.
items.notes: Mechanical change but touches every backend implementation. Easier to do now with 2 backends than later with N. Prerequisite for FederatedDataSource fan-out.

items.name: query_monitoring_and_docs
items.description: Production polish: query latency logging, connection pool metrics, alert thresholds, and docs sweep to update stale decision ID format references across ~10 doc files.
items.notes: Docs: entity_id_namespace.md updated but ~10 other files still reference old decision:{jur}:{date}:{item} format. Monitoring: per-corpus query times already logged but not persisted or alerted on.

items.name: multi_issuer_lookup
items.description: Update issuer_lookup signature from (jurisdiction) -> Optional[str] to (jurisdiction) -> List[TrustedIssuer] with validity windows and trust levels. Informed by testbed findings.
items.notes: Current single-pubkey return is too simple for cross-county trust. With 3 test issuers, can validate the new signature before going live.

items.name: federation_adr
items.description: Write Architecture Decision Record documenting federation boundaries: which protocols change, which stay, execution model for cross-jurisdiction queries, and trust chain design.
items.notes: Written after testbed findings, not before. This ADR should reflect what was learned, not what was assumed.

items.name: simbli_discovery_integration
items.description: Wire existing SimbliClient into discovery chain (factory, platform_detection, onboard). Make BaseExtractor-compatible. Simbli serves school boards via Playwright-based scraping at simbli.eboardsolutions.com.

items.name: universal_adapter_design
items.description: Design session: LLM-powered universal adapter for cities with custom platforms (Portland, NYC). Research declarative scraping configs, LLM-inferred selectors, failure modes. Output: ADR + prototype design.

items.name: v2_adapter_storage_refactor
items.description: Refactored v2 corpus adapters to call storage/vector backends directly. Removed CivicOS middleman. Cross-jurisdiction no longer creates CivicOS instances.
items.source: architectural review — v2 query layer cleanup
items.notes: Cross-jurisdiction testing (2026-03-14) hit connection pool exhaustion and cold-start thundering herd from creating CivicOS instances per jurisdiction. Current workarounds (shared backends, warm-then-fan-out, 20s timeout) are duct tape. Removing the CivicOS middleman is the clean fix.

items.name: direct_city_submission
items.description: Authenticated endpoint for city clerks to submit meeting data directly (PDF upload + metadata). Bypasses scraping entirely. Extension UI for drag-and-drop upload.
items.source: onboarding friction — scraping is fragile, cities already have the data
items.notes: Trivial implementation: POST endpoint accepts {title, date, board, pdf_file}, runs AgendaPacketParser, calls store_meetings() + store_chunks(). Auth via API key per jurisdiction. Extension gets Upload Agenda button. Scraping pipeline remains as fallback for historical data and non-adopting cities. 1-2 sessions of work.
